tasks.title: Book-copy management functionality
tasks.description: Implement features for librarians to add and update book-copy records and record the return of borrowed copies.

tasks.title: Member browsing and authentication
tasks.description: Implement browsing for members and authentication checks for borrowing and viewing personal loans.

tasks.title: Loan management and validation
tasks.description: Implement loan creation with validation for availability, user loan limits, and restriction to personal loans.

tasks.title: Loan lifecycle management
tasks.description: Implement checks to ensure no copy has multiple active loans and that returning a copy updates availability.

tasks.title: Localization
tasks.description: Ensure the application interface displays in English.

acceptance_criteria.given: A Librarian is signed into the system
acceptance_criteria.when: the Librarian submits a new book record or updates an existing record
acceptance_criteria.then: the system records the new or updated book-copy details

acceptance_criteria.given: A Member is not signed in
acceptance_criteria.when: the Member accesses the browse page
acceptance_criteria.then: the system displays the list of available copies

acceptance_criteria.given: A Member is not signed in
acceptance_criteria.when: the Member attempts to borrow a copy
acceptance_criteria.then: the system redirects the Member to sign in before processing the request

acceptance_criteria.given: A Member is not signed in
acceptance_criteria.when: the Member attempts to view their current loans
acceptance_criteria.then: the system redirects the Member to sign in before displaying the loans

acceptance_criteria.when: the Member accesses their current loans view
acceptance_criteria.then: the system displays only the loans associated with that specific Member

acceptance_criteria.given: A Member has two active loans
acceptance_criteria.when: the Member borrows a third copy
acceptance_criteria.then: the system successfully creates the third loan record

acceptance_criteria.given: A Member has three active loans
acceptance_criteria.when: the Member attempts to borrow a fourth copy
acceptance_criteria.then: the system refuses the loan and does not create a fourth record

acceptance_criteria.given: A copy has an existing active loan
acceptance_criteria.when: a Member attempts to borrow that same copy
acceptance_criteria.then: the system refuses the loan request

acceptance_criteria.when: the Librarian records the return of a borrowed copy
acceptance_criteria.then: the system marks the return status for that copy

acceptance_criteria.given: A copy is currently on loan
acceptance_criteria.when: any member attempts to borrow the same copy
acceptance_criteria.then: the system prevents the creation of a second active loan for that copy

acceptance_criteria.given: A copy has been returned by a Librarian
acceptance_criteria.when: the copy record is retrieved for browsing
acceptance_criteria.then: the system lists the copy as available

acceptance_criteria.given: The system is loaded in a browser
acceptance_criteria.when: any user accesses the application interface
acceptance_criteria.then: all text components are presented in English

acceptance_criteria.given: A copy is available and the Member is signed in
acceptance_criteria.then: the system creates a loan record for the Member

open_questions.question: Is there a required response time for library loan operations, or should this remain unconstrained for the first release?
